author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Half of implemented recommendations took under 17 months; one in ten took more than four years.
paragraphs: Time to implement is measured from the report date to the follow-up that first recorded 'implemented', so it is rounded up to the follow-up cadence (about six months for the Controller). The step curves show, for recommendations issued in each year, the share implemented within N months; recent years are cut off where they cannot yet be observed.
High-priority recommendations are not implemented faster on average.

templates.template: {impl_fmt} implemented recommendations, {years}: median {median_months} months, 75th percentile {p75_months}, 90th percentile {p90_months}.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.

caveats.text: Recommendations still open are excluded from the medians (survivor bias); the step curves correct for this.
